direction-type.words: Ally bally, ally bally bee. Fin ye grow up ye'll ging tae sea.
Makin' pennies for your mammie and me. Tae buy some Coulter's Candy.
Peer wee Jeannie, she's gettin' awfie thin. She's a rickle o' bains covered ower wi' skin.
Noo she's gettin' a wee double chin, fae sookin' Coulter's Candy.
Oor wee Annie, she's greetin' ana, but peer wee mammie she's thinkin' braw.
She'll gi'e them a penny atween thae twa, tae buy mair Coulter's Candy.
Wullie grat baith lang and sair, 'til he got a penny tae wear.
Noo he's rumblin' doon the stair, tae buy some Coulter's Candy.
